title: Netflix names former Disney executive Rice as new content chief as Bajaria departs
key_facts: Netflix said Peter Rice will join as Chief Content Officer effective 26 Oct 2026, replacing Bela Bajaria, who is leaving after nearly 10 years
Rice was most recently Chairman of Walt Disney Television and of General Entertainment at Disney; earlier at Fox
As CCO he leads Netflix's global content organization across scripted, unscripted, film and live events
Variety says about 1,000 employees (6% of the company) were laid off this week, Netflix's largest cut yet
Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos thanked Bajaria in a statement
Netflix won 16 Primetime Emmys in 2026 versus 30 in 2025, per Variety
quote_evidence: Bela Bajaria is out at Netflix after 10 years at the streamer, most recently serving as its chief content officer.
She will be replaced by former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice, as first reported by Puck.
Around 1,000 employees (6% of the company) were laid off this week in what marks the streamer's largest axing to date.
why_it_matters_hint: Netflix has a new head of content in the same week as its biggest layoff.
